scheme_name: Grant for the Purchase of Work Related Tools for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: The applicant must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must be registered under the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board for not less than 3 years.
The applicant must remit their contribution regularly.
benefits_summary: A grant of ₹5,000 for the purchase of work‑related tools, available once every five years.
